old: Help text is wrapped at a maximum width of 80 columns.
new: Help text is wrapped at a maximum width of 100 columns.

old: The progress bar is 30 characters wide and filled with '#'.
new: The progress bar is 40 characters wide and filled with '='.

old: Pausing shows the message 'Press any key to continue...'.
new: Pausing shows the message 'Hit enter to go on...'.

old: A confirmation prompt accepts y or yes as agreement.
new: A confirmation prompt accepts only yes as agreement.

old: The --yes option asks 'Do you want to continue?' before running.
new: The --yes option never asks before running.

old: The password option hides what the user types and asks twice.
new: The password option shows what the user types and asks once.

old: The --help option is eager and prints the help page, then exits.
new: The --help option prints the help page and keeps running.

old: On Windows the app config folder is under the APPDATA directory.
new: On Windows the app config folder is under the user home directory.

old: The values 1, yes, true, y and on are read as True.
new: Only the values true and false are accepted as booleans.

old: Choice options are case sensitive by default.
new: Choice options ignore case by default.

old: The --version option prints the program name and version, then exits.
new: The --version option prints only the version number.

old: Long output is shown through a pager.
new: Long output is printed directly without a pager.

old: Styled text is reset to normal at the end by default.
new: Styled text stays styled after the end by default.

old: Prompts end with a colon and a space after the question.
new: Prompts end with a question mark.

old: Failed commands are retried three times.
new: Failed commands are retried five times.

old: Usage statistics are uploaded to a server.
